default.notes: Apply for the single-entry tourist eVisa on the Visa-Migration Portal (vmp.gov.kz); nationalities outside the eVisa scheme must apply at a Kazakh embassy.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 30 days per visit, capped at 90 days in total within any 180-day period.
Visa-free under CIS/EAEU arrangements for up to 90 days; your host must notify the migration service within 3 working days of arrival.

KZ.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Kazakh citizens.

AF.notes: Not covered by the eVisa scheme — apply at a Kazakh embassy; an invitation and additional vetting are usually required.

XK.notes: Kazakhstan does not recognise Kosovo — travel on a Kosovo-issued passport is generally not possible; contact a Kazakh embassy about alternatives.
